t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There may be a correlation between the colour of the gnome's hat and the colour of the basket. Purple and Blue 'tall hat' gnomes and Green 'short hat' gnome seemed to give the most mushrooms, but this seemed to change as the game progressed.

vb_textbox.text: In my opinion, the best approach to this game is through trial and error.My advice is to use the x1 rounds to try and determine which gnomes give the higher mushroom count. Then make sure to always pick that gnome when they appear during the x5 rounds.Keep in mind that the value might change, possibly between breaks, possibly more often than that. Don't hesitate to use the x1 rounds to double check that the gnomes you've  been avoiding haven't changed their values.Have fun!
